helper: check_tax.py v1 (written by the B09 Claude lead)

families.A1: all ordered pairs (g,h) of Boolean sign functions on n_data=1,2,3 data bits (4^2, 16^2, 256^2 pairs); f(X,y)=g(y) if X=0, h(y) if X=1; rare bit X ~ Ber(p)
families.A2: the scalar fiber minimum m(p)=min_phi h2(sin^2 phi)+h2(sin^2(phi+theta)), sin^2 theta=p, on a p-grid in (0,1/2]
families.A3: two-bit AND f=1-2XY, Y~Ber(1/4), p=2^-k, k=3..60
families.B: A043 composition identity on 6 explicit disjoint compositions (maj3, xor-and gates) with unequal biases, n<=7 physical bits
families.C: A041 refresh inequality on 40 seeded random real-weight thresholds, n<=8, random interior biases, r in {1,2,4}, eps in {1/4,1/2,1}

case_count: A1: 3 bias vectors x 5 p x (16+256+65536) pairs = 991,440 pair evaluations
arithmetic: IEEE double (numpy) for A1,A2,B,C; mpmath 60 digits for A3. Floating point is evidence only; the theorem is proved analytically in REPORT.md.
randomness: B and C use numpy default_rng(20261011)
